headline: Research, the competitor check and the validation kit are done, and the web checker is built and tested. The iOS app is being built now. This week is your setup week, so the forum posts can start on Mon Oct 26.

todos.title: Form an LLC and check the TailBook name
todos.detail: Search USPTO (TESS) and the App Store for "TailBook" before you pay for anything.

todos.title: Buy the domain and set up email
todos.detail: e.g. tailbook.app, plus Google Workspace for a real address.

todos.title: Join the Apple Developer Program
todos.detail: Enroll as the LLC so the app ships under the company name.

todos.title: Create the Stripe $49 deposit link and the Tally form
todos.detail: Then paste both links into the landing page (send them to the team).

todos.title: Recruit an IA advisor to review the rules
todos.detail: A paid mechanic with Inspection Authorization checks the engine and the Snapshot template.

todos.title: Join COPA and MAPA, and warm up your forum profiles
todos.detail: Real name, short honest bio. Read 20 threads before you post anything.

todos.title: Do 2–3 owner interviews
todos.detail: Mom Test style: ask about the past, not about the idea.

todos.title: Deploy the landing page
todos.detail: Drag landing/index.html onto Netlify Drop, then point the domain at it.

decisions.question: Continue with TailBook as-is, adjust pricing, or switch niche?
decisions.context: 25+ rival apps exist (Coflyt, Aircraft Compliance, BetterPlane), most at $0–$140/yr. Revenue estimate is now ~$80k–$500k/yr.
decisions.recommendation: Adjust pricing: test $129/$149/$199 deposits, launch through one type club, keep the Dec 15 go/no-go.

decisions.question: Is a small niche OK? (now ~$80k–$500k a year, revised down from ~$1–2M)
decisions.context: TailBook serves US Part 91 owners. The competitor check cut the revenue estimate, so this is a lifestyle-sized business unless a type-club channel works. The bigger alternative (#2, real-estate hours tracking) is a more crowded market.
decisions.recommendation: Decide together with the competitor question above.

decisions.question: Approve the ~$2,350 validation budget?
decisions.context: LLC, domain, email, analytics, COPA and MAPA, an IA advisor (~$1,500) and a lawyer review (~$500). Without the advisor and the lawyer it is about $360.
decisions.recommendation: Approve. The IA advisor is the main trust signal for pilots.

decisions.question: Keep the name TailBook?
decisions.context: Only if the USPTO and App Store checks come back clean. Changing the name later costs a new domain and new forum posts.
decisions.recommendation: Keep it if the checks are clean.

headlineDecision.title: The competitor check changes the picture
headlineDecision.summary: The competitor check found 25+ rival apps (Coflyt, Aircraft Compliance, BetterPlane), so the market is crowded rather than empty. Revenue estimate revised to ~$80k–$500k/yr. Recommendation: keep the Dec 15 go/no-go, test $129/$149/$199 deposit prices, and launch through one type club.
